session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Big Gap Up Then Bull Trending Trading Range Day'. Overnight session x-axis is ET+12 hours (22:00-04:00 vs the original 10:00-16:00 ET labels). Big gap up above yesterday's high 7270, opening double bottom, bull spike, blue shaded trading range with failed 2nd entry sell setups, breakout into a tight bull channel, all-time high tested before end-of-day profit taking and a new all-time high in the after-close extension.

events.outcome_reason: gap above yesterday's high shook out shorts and reversed up with a double bottom

events.outcome_reason: strong bull legs lifted the market from 7272 to 7282
events.evidence: bars 12 and 18 labels under the green arrow spike bars below the shaded box
